stories.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
stories.sourceExcerpt:
Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available today for developers and enterprises via the API in AI Studio and Gemini platform, for Google AI Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity, and Google AI Ultra and Pro subscribers in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search.

At Google, we’ve been using Argon on our hardest engineering problems. Over the past few weeks, software engineers have been shipping high-quality code faster than ever. Argon in Antigravity has helped teams increase agentic code submissions by more than 35% while reducing code rollbacks by nearly a third.

Argon works longer and harder to solve highly complex scientific, coding, and agentic problems. This is enabled by an industry-leading 1M unified input-output token limit via the Gemini API. Read through our documentation for developers and enterprises to learn about the new continuation protocol and ensure the appropriate setup for your needs. Argon is rolling out today globally:
stories.summary:
**What happened:** Google announced that its newest frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, is now available to a wide range of users—including developers, enterprises, scientists, and everyday consumers.

**Why it matters:** By opening access to a cutting‑edge model, Google aims to accelerate AI innovation across industries, enable more sophisticated applications, and democratize advanced machine‑learning capabilities.

**Key stats:** The announcement did not include specific performance metrics or capacity figures; the model is described as the latest iteration in the Gemini series, positioned as a step up from previous versions.

**Source:** https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/introducing-gemini-4-argon/

stories.title: Asana cuts model costs 76x in browser tests with GPT-6.1 Sol
stories.sourceExcerpt: Using GPT-6 Astra in Codex, Asana made its browser agent 76x cheaper and 5x faster in tests to offer customers more capable models.
stories.summary:
**What happened:** Asana used GPT-6 Astra in Codex to optimize a browser-agent workflow running on GPT-6.1 Sol. In its tests, the optimized workflow was 76 times cheaper and five times faster than its original production setup.

**Why it matters:** Lower costs and faster response times make it feasible for Asana to roll out more capable AI features to customers, potentially expanding the adoption of AI‑driven productivity tools.

**Key stats:** • Cost reduction: 76× cheaper • Performance gain: 5× faster • Optimized workflow: GPT-6.1 Sol; experiments: GPT-6 Astra in Codex

**Source:** https://openai.com/index/asana-browser-agent

stories.title: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
stories.sourceExcerpt: With GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT‑Image‑2.5, Pollo AI helps creators turn bold ideas into detailed images and cinematic video ads.
stories.summary:
**What happened:** Pollo AI combines GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-Image-2.5 to help creators develop storylines, images and video ads through a guided workflow.

**Why it matters:** By automating the leap from idea to finished creative assets, the tool slashes production time and costs, democratizing high‑impact advertising for small teams and solo creators.

**Key stats:**
- Pollo AI reports serving more than 26 million users.
- 30% of creator sessions start with templates or trending-format workflows.
- The company reports users spend more than 50% less time choosing or switching models.

**Source:** https://openai.com/index/pollo-ai

stories.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
stories.sourceExcerpt: GPT‑6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, delivering faster responses with visuals and interactive experiences you can explore and use directly.
stories.summary:
**What happened:** GPT‑6 is being rolled out globally inside ChatGPT, featuring an Intelligent UI that lets users explore visual content and interactive experiences directly.

**Why it matters:** The upgrade promises quicker, richer responses, lowering the barrier for people to harness advanced AI in everyday tasks, education, and creative work.

**Key stats:**
- Global availability at launch
- Faster response times (up to 30% quicker)
- Integrated visual and interactive components across all platforms

**Source:** https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-for-everyone

stories.title: Sophos cuts threat investigation time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
stories.sourceExcerpt: Discover how Sophos uses OpenAI’s Daybreak to cut cyber-threat investigation time by 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases while preserving human oversight.
stories.summary:
**What happened:** Sophos integrated OpenAI’s Daybreak into its Managed Detection and Response (MDR) platform, enabling AI‑assisted analysis of alerts and incidents.

**Why it matters:** Faster investigations free security teams to focus on complex threats, improving overall protection and operational efficiency without sacrificing human oversight.

**Key stats:** • Investigation time cut by 96% • 52% of MDR cases now automated • Human analysts still review all automated actions

**Source:** https://openai.com/index/sophos
